Edition compass · Case 01 · Anna · Joint version 1.1 · 27 October 2026 · Material

Opportunities, risks and countermeasures

Editorial classification for the model case before additional measures. Plausibility is not a measured probability; effect means the benefit in case of opportunities, an undesirable consequence in case of risks. Unexplained cases remain outside the quadrants. Anna's average values are bundled in the compact view to the left or bottom; the exact classification is in the table and in her detail matrix.

Support

Opportunity · Plausibility medium · Effect medium

Appropriate expertise is conceivable; a commitment and a professional profit are initially open.

How does Git help?

Action: Setting up access suitable for contributors, initially only reading if necessary. Arrange an understandable review section, feedback channel, integration responsibility and form of recognition.

Responsible for: Anna and possible contributors

Revision

Chance · Plausibility medium · Effect high

New insights are plausible; corrections concern central edition goals. A well-kept output path is a prerequisite.

How does Git help?

Action: Set a simple version and citation rule. Mark important states with clearly named, briefly explained tags and transfer them explicitly to the hosting service; an ordinary push does not automatically transmit all tags. Set public tags only in the adjusted publication repository. Reason changes, receive old release states and point out in the next release the differences to the book or the previous data version.

Responsible for: Anna; technical counter-reading and publication/archive service if required

Teaching

Opportunity · Plausibility medium · Effect medium

Anna is interested in teaching; a specific appointment is open at first.

How does Git help?

Action: Preparing teaching, reading and feedback channels; identifying quality status and taking over as well as recognising student contributions.

Responsible for: Anna as a teacher, student and if necessary teaching/infrastructure support

Partial publication

Opportunity · Plausibility medium · Effect medium

A finished subset can already be usable; volume and demand remain open.

How does Git help?

Action: Select an independently understandable subset, check references and rights, attach README and version information and document approval as well as archive transfer.

Responsible for: Anna; if necessary, expert review, metadata consulting and archive service

Book publication

Chance · Plausibility unexplained · Effect high

A publishing house could enable editing, design and appropriate dissemination. A request is not required; rights, costs and the relationship to open data collection must be clarified.

How does Git help?

Action: It is clear early on whether open data, minimal frontend and subsequent revisions will remain possible next to the book edition. Services, costs, rights, version assignment and correction with the publisher concretely agree; disclose existing licenses.

Responsible for: Anna and interested publisher; expert advice on contract and rights issues

Computer failure

Risk · Plausibility medium · Effect high

Git and Uni-GitLab can back up the transferred edition files, including history, against computer loss. Untransmitted changes and unsecured external files remain at risk; Anna's actual routine is still unclear.

How does Git help?

Action: Regularly commit and push. Repo test in a fresh folder clone, check older stands as well as preview and document what is saved. For further files set a supplementary backup path.

Responsible for: Anna; the hosting service is responsible for its agreed operation, direct help only if necessary

Repo access

Risk · Plausibility unexplained · Effect high

The longer-term account rule has not yet been clarified.

How does Git help?

Action: After the removal manual, create a new destination, transfer data and history, test a fresh copy and document the new location.

Responsible for: Anna on the basis of guidance; competent body clarifies the old access, technical assistance in special cases

Advice

Risk · Plausibility unexplained · Effect medium

The duration and alternatives of institutional support are still open.

How does Git help?

Action: To clarify consultation conditions, to document important routines with examples and to look for a realistic replacement contact for special cases. Keep the work path so easy that ongoing help is rarely necessary.

Responsible for: Anna and the existing or possible new advisory centre

Tool change

Risk · Plausibility unexplained · Effect medium

The longer-term tool permission has not yet been checked. TEI files remain editable.

How does Git help?

Action: Check permission; if necessary edit, validate and output a representative section in the alternative work path. Document differences and necessary steps in a short guide.

Responsible for: Anna; License Management clarifies eligibility, point-by-point facility assistance if required

Confidence

Risk · Plausibility medium · Effect high

Unchecked exports or history could reveal internal content; distribution is hard to recover.

How does Git help?

Action: Check files, metadata and achievable history for publication; take an adjusted export to the separate publication repository and check a fresh public copy.

Responsible for: Anna and Mira for internal handling; Anna is responsible for the approval

Continuation

Risk · Plausibility unexplained · Effect high

A failure is not assumed; concentration of knowledge and responsibility could make it difficult to continue.

How does Git help?

Action: Arrange a consenting contact person or a carrier, clean accesses and create a small transfer package. Check with a test run if another person can generate an output from it.

Responsible for: Anna and expressly agreed representation or hosting institution

Additional expenditure

Risk · Plausibility medium · Effect medium

Contributions and partial approvals create queries and additional testing tasks. Scope is still open.

How does Git help?

Action: Arrange a small order, a matching return channel and a realistic period of time. Do not trigger more contributions at the same time than Anna can understand.

Responsible for: Anna and each participating participant

Host Change

Risk · Plausibility unexplained · Effect high

The portability of the preview and output to be set up is not proven.

How does Git help?

Action: Use a small example to test the local output path and write down required tools. When changing, adjust host settings and web address separately; then check references and output.

Responsible for: Anna using the operating instructions; installation and special cases with technical assistance
